extension.description: Edit Excel and CSV files directly in VS Code, with formulas, table filters, formatting, charts and AI agent tools.
configuration.headlessWrites: Allow AI agent tools to modify spreadsheet files that are not open in an editor. Changes are saved to disk. Requires a trusted workspace.
workspaceTrust.description: The spreadsheet editor is available in Restricted Mode. AI agent tools can modify unopened files only in trusted workspaces.
